[P2] Keep a bounded clock hold for detached runners

An abandoned invoke can still produce a callback that its live caller awaits. For example, the child resumes after a one-hour wait, then runs a callback-sending step involving short real I/O alongside a longer durable wait; the caller races that callback against a two-hour wait. Removing the child from `participants` lets processing its longer wait advance the clock to the caller's deadline while the callback step runs, allowing the timeout to win incorrectly. The added callback test has no competing deadline and misses this case. Retain a bounded hold for busy detached runners, expiring it for never-settling work, and add the callback/deadline regression.
